config.packdev_toolkit.title: Packdev Toolkit Config
config.packdev_toolkit.option.resource_p: The directory that assets and models are written to. Can be relative to the game directory or an absolute path (e.g. C:/Minecraft/resourcepacks/MyPack).
config.packdev_toolkit.option.data_pack_: The directory that recipe and data exports are written to. Can be relative to the game directory or an absolute path (e.g. C:/Minecraft/config/openloader/data/MyDatapack).
config.packdev_toolkit.option.queries_ex: The directory that query dumps are written to. Can be relative to the game directory or an absolute path (e.g. C:/Minecraft/queries).
command.packdev_toolkit.dump.hand_empty: You are not holding an item.
